title: Annotatio IV §.I: Soul of the orthodox sentence — true real presence and participation of body and blood
pass_a_gloss: But that the Body and Blood of Christ are truly and really, properly and apart from every figure, present in the Sacred Eucharist, and are participated in by all who use the Sacred Supper according to Christ’s Institution, is the soul of the true, genuine, and orthodox sentence concerning the Sacred Supper.
pass_b_english: The soul of the true, genuine, orthodox Supper sentence is this:
Christ’s Body and Blood are truly and really present in the Eucharist — properly, not by bare figure — and are participated in by all who use the Supper per Christ’s Institution.
source_text: At verò Corpus & Sanguinem Christi, verè ac realiter, propriè & citra omnem figuram, in S. Eucharistia, & præsentia esse, & ab omnibus, juxta Institutionem Christi S. Cœnâ utentibus, participari, veræ, genuinæ & orthodoxæ de S. Cœna sententiæ animam expedit.
